## API Reference

### Pets API

#### GET /pets

URL: https://docs.example.com/api/pets/get-pets

List pets

Returns pets.

Parameters: query.limit

Responses: 200

```bash
curl https://x/pets
```

#### POST /pets

URL: https://docs.example.com/api/pets/post-pets

Parameters: none

Responses: none

```bash
curl -X POST https://x/pets
```

#### Pet

URL: https://docs.example.com/api/pets/models/pet

```typescript
type Pet = {}
```

#### Owner

URL: https://docs.example.com/api/pets/models/owner

```typescript
type Owner = {}
```
